title: Sending a report to a file, an e-mail and the archive from the controller
instruction: Ground with get_knowledge(topic="report-print-destinations"). In the sandbox model write an SrsReportRunController subclass that overrides preRunModifyContract() - after the dialog, before the run, so the user's other choices survive - and sets the print destination from code. Show the file/PDF form (printMediumType(SRSPrintMediumType::File), fileFormat(SRSReportFileFormat::PDF), fileName, overwriteFile), the e-mail form via settings.parmEMailContract() with parmTo/parmSubject/parmAttachmentFileFormat, and parmPrintToArchive for the archive. Use only enum members that exist: the mediums are Screen/Printer/File/Email/Custom/Archive and the formats are CSV/Excel/HTML4_0/Image/MHTML/PDF/XML/Word - inventing one FAILS this case. Do NOT reach for SrsProxy.renderReportToByteArray: it compiles but the compiler answers that SrsProxy is marked InternalUseOnly. Build with zero errors and zero BP errors.
